pages.title: A friend from Italy · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday evening at a small party in Seattle. Music plays and people talk in groups. Bruno arrives with his friend Marco from Italy. Marco does not know anyone here. Bruno sees his coworker Pia near the window. He takes Marco over to say hello.
“Pia, this is my friend Marco.” says Bruno. “Hi, Marco! Nice to meet you.” says Pia. “Marco, this is my coworker Pia.” says Bruno.
